datasets.name: ViewGroup
datasets.sql:
Select
   id,
   name,
   amort,
   taxamort, 
   main_account,SB_COMPLEX_TRANSACTIONS.GetAccountNumber(main_account) as MainAccNo,
   exp_account,SB_COMPLEX_TRANSACTIONS.GetAccountNumber(exp_account) as DebtAccNo,
   amort_account,SB_COMPLEX_TRANSACTIONS.GetAccountNumber(amort_account) as CreditAccNo,
   sale_account,SB_COMPLEX_TRANSACTIONS.GetAccountNumber(sale_account) as SaleAccNo
From
   Groups

datasets.name: ExcelPreviewGroups
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  G.ID,
  Max (G.name),
  Max (G.amort),
  Sum (W.first_price),
  Sum (W.balance_price),
  Sum(W.allamort)
FROM
   Wares W,
   Groups G
   WHERE G.ID = W.GroupsID
GROUP BY G.ID
ORDER BY G.ID

datasets.name: ODSTransaction
datasets.sql:
Select
  G.ID,
   max(G.name) as Name,
     max(G.main_account) as Main_account ,   
     max(G.exp_account) as Exp_account ,
     max(G.amort_account) as Amort_account,
     max(G.Sale_account) as Sale_account,
      sum(W.remainder) as Rest
From
   Wares W,
     Groups G
Where
   G.ID=W.GroupsID and W.close_format <>2

Group by G.ID
